submitted.rationale: XRD found the same rutile-type phase at indices 0, 5, 12 and 20, with no clear secondary phase except a weak peak (Q 1.91) at 20. EQE rose steadily as Fe increased: 0.005% at Fe 0.51 (index 12), 0.014% at Fe 0.71 (index 5), and 0.055% at Fe 0.81 (index 0). Index 0 is the most Fe-rich composition in the library and had the highest EQE measured.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.0050%, the lowest of the three
EQE fell as Sb increased and XRD at index 20 showed the same phase, so no reason to expect improvement there
